t2.thesis: CMG is washed out at 52-week lows with a roughly 7.5% implied move and a beaten-down setup, but a slow start to Q4, an analyst downgrade and the salmonella overhang offset the positioning edge, so the call stays close to the base rate.
reasons: Stock is down 32% over 12 months and 12% over 1 month, at 52-week lows, so expectations are low and a relief rally is plausible.
Short interest is low at 3.4%, and the RBC preview flags comp upside from promotions and digital engagement.
A long-standing bull downgraded on a slow start to Q4, which points to soft Q4-to-date comps and guidance risk.
The July 8-K said guidance excluded any salmonella impact, and the 10-Q warns of low-single-digit comp headwinds.
The implied move is about 7.5%, and the last four prints show 2 up and 2 down with big magnitudes, so the outcome is close to a coin flip with a slight positive drift.
t2.deciding_variable: Q3 comps and traffic, together with management's commentary on Q4-to-date trends and the 2026 comp guide.

theses.expected: Relief rally on in-line comps and a maintained guide
theses.mechanism: Depressed price and sentiment mean that a merely acceptable print squeezes out the bears, and buybacks add support.
theses.wrong_if: Q4-to-date comps are negative or the full-year comp guide is cut.

theses.expected: Selloff on weak traffic and margin pressure
theses.mechanism: Beef and freight inflation, labor costs and the salmonella impact compress margins while comps slow.
theses.wrong_if: Restaurant-level margin comes in at or above 25% with positive traffic.

theses.expected: Muted move with a mixed print
theses.mechanism: IV is elevated at 2.2x realized volatility, so the implied move overprices the actual reaction.
theses.wrong_if: The stock moves more than 8% in either direction.
